But I'll take "radical" from a billionaire bully as a badge of honor. Maybe I'll even frame his post and hang it next to my medals.
Because he obviously knows this district is up for grabs and that I'm here to check his power.
We already know how Keith Self is acting through all this. When asked about my challenge to debate, to have any conversation at all, he wouldn't commit. He said, "This is my seat."
His seat.
In the same interview, he admitted that his race is normally over in the primary, but this year, he said he's "running a strong general race just to make sure."
We have to stay vigilant. Last week, Keith Self told Fox News he could try to use a maneuver to block Democrats from being sworn in.
That's not democracy. And it tells us even more just how scared they are.
I swore an oath to the Constitution. Not to Donald Trump. I'm not here to bend the knee; I'm here to work for the people of TX-03 and this country.

I'm not surprised. These are the same people who are defending fraudsters who stole $9B in tax dollars intended to feed hungry children.

We must be doing something right.

| | On Wednesday night, I faced Maggie Goodlander live on the big debate stage under the bright lights.

I went in with a game plan to lower your costs. She played the Blame Game all night.

So I kept count. Can you guess how many times she blamed Trump, for her own failures? **[Watch 30 sec: Maggie Goodlander plays the Blame Game](https://us.list-manage.com/tm9ZofxynlP?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)** I really hope that no viewers at home decided to turn this into a drinking game...
# **WATCH MY OTHER HIGHLIGHTS**
**The full debate.**
See it all, start to finish, and join the conversation in the comments.
[Watch the full debate](https://us.list-manage.com/122YjtO4ye5?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**"Trump, not China."**
She said President Trump, not Communist China, is the greatest threat to America. I grew up under Mao, and I answered her.
[Watch the clip](https://us.list-manage.com/YjCGyEvuo60?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**My closing statement.**
My final pitch to Granite Staters, straight from the WMUR stage.
[Watch on WMUR](https://us.list-manage.com/uP_kWdHTrXQ?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**Before the cameras rolled.**
Team Lily turned out in force to wave signs in Manchester, and I made sure to thank every one of them before I walked in.
[Watch the sign wave](https://us.list-manage.com/WgWgsHs5ZHn?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c) | [Watch my thank-you](https://us.list-manage.com/g9bpvyN7dsv?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

I am humbled by their trust. [See the full list.](https://us.list-manage.com/K8035H7oDVj?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

body:
Plus: How to help San Juan County before the next storm hits | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/wzBRN5WeY6H?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Two days before the election, a Democratic congresswoman in Michigan stood next to the Republican running for Senate and told voters she’s with him. Her party chair says she’s no longer a Democrat. [We tell you why we think it matters beyond Michigan.](https://us.list-manage.com/11gBc9w1HnT?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
Then we go to San Juan County, where 1,500 homes took on water and more rain is on the way. Sheriff Ken Christesen and volunteer Jamie Decker join us from Farmington to tell you what they need. Everything you need to give is at the bottom of this email.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/spnAN_Fp_fE?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🔥 HALEY STEVENS WALKED AWAY FROM HER OWN PARTY’S NOMINEE**
Haley Stevens lost the Michigan Senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed by one point. On Sunday morning, after church in Detroit, she stood next to Mike Rogers and said, “We can’t stand with hate.”
She didn’t do this out of nowhere. There’s an ad, a streamer named Hasan Piker, and a message from El-Sayed’s campaign telling her to stay away. We walk through all of it, and we explain what she may know about this race that the polls don’t.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/10hhOD0oxZq?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**🌊 1,500 HOMES, A RIVER ABOVE ITS 1909 RECORD, AND MORE RAIN COMING**
Sheriff Christesen says the flooding runs from Pagosa Springs to Bluff, Utah, and that without Navajo Dam it would have been thousands more homes. What’s in the river now is the part people don’t understand, and he lays it out.
Jamie Decker hadn’t left her house since the rain started. Her neighborhood in Harper Valley didn’t wait for anyone to show up. She tells us how they did it, and what she needs most this week.

**🗳️ 434,818 NEW MEXICANS HAVE VOTED. REPUBLICANS ARE BEHIND 2022.**
We pulled the Secretary of State numbers and compared them to four years ago. One number is nearly identical to 2022. Another one isn’t, and it’s the one Republicans need to see before Tuesday.
We also go through who showed up on Election Day last time, and why the gap you’re hearing about doesn’t have to be erased for Republicans to win statewide.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/v_A69W5g2WI?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**PLUS:** Our final Senate predictions, state by state, on the record. We agree on Iowa, Alaska, Maine, Michigan and Texas and split on Ohio and Kansas. One of us has it 53-47 and the other 51-49, and we’re both going against Jay McCleskey on Texas. Also: three bobcats on the trail cam, and wild turkeys on a car in Fort Collins that Mark’s brother-in-law did not bring home for Thanksgiving.

**🤝 HOW TO HELP SAN JUAN COUNTY**
If you’re far away, money moves fastest. [San Juan United Way is coordinating supplies and cash for Farmington and Bloomfield](https://us.list-manage.com/apbVHN20nTT?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e).
Drop-off for supplies: San Juan United Way, 903 W. Apache St., Farmington. Call ahead to confirm hours and current needs.

With Election Day tomorrow, we wanted to share what Janelle is hearing from Pennsylvanians about Scott Perry's "leadership" on the campaign trail. **Janelle asked, "Scott Perry wrote that his policies are winning the war on high prices. What do you think?"** |

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Hey
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
#

Peter, there's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted.
Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes.
**I will not be distracted.** Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders.
— This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.
— This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach.
— And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades.
Please don’t get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won’t.
Election Day is Tuesday. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to 20,217 votes.
**I’m told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now.**
[**Please split a donation of $10 or any amount right now to fund Ruben Gallego and our last get-out-the-vote ads before polls close on Tuesday.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-abdul.-jNLJo&refcode=em261102-1-90-partner_ms_aes_em_gallego&t=1&akid=4234%2E734936%2EZoQghq)
[DONATE $10](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-abdul.-jNLJo&refcode=em261102-1-90-partner_ms_aes_em_gallego&amount=10&t=2&akid=4234%2E734936%2EZoQghq)
Let them have the drama. Let us earn the votes.
Abdul

And with Election Day just hours away, we can’t slow down our outreach. We’ve got to get more people to the polls in a massive show of strength for our democracy. = Every message we send costs less than a penny, but the expense adds up quickly when you’re trying to reach millions of voters. name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: My last email before the polls close
body:
|
#
Friend, This is the last email I’ll send you before the polls close. Before we head into the final hours of this campaign, I wanted to share a few things I’ve been thinking about. Over these last two years, I’ve had the chance to sit down with folks all across mid-Michigan: at union halls and diners, on front porches and in church basements. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142784003/658054376/264474622?refcode=em-11.2.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZmZkNjllOC0yMWQ3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vxXgN019mLlES0pKxFshA1kl1KFwvVg5prUWRGnmFZY=) So many people have told me the same thing in different ways. They’re working hard, doing everything right, and still coming up short at the end of the month. Groceries, prescriptions, child care, rent: it all adds up, and for a lot of families, there's just not enough left over. But those conversations are also what keep me going. Every time someone tells me what they’re carrying, I’m reminded why I do this work: to fight for affordable health care, to protect programs like SNAP and Medicare, and to bring costs down so working families can get ahead again. And to do it by bringing people together, not pulling them apart. That’s why this fight is bigger than this race. Sean McCann in MI-04 and Christina Hines in MI-10 are running because they believe what I believe: that anyone in Michigan who works hard should be able to buy a home, raise a family, and retire with dignity. With them in Congress, we can get so much more done for this state – and the nation. **All three of our races are close, and they’ll come down to what we do in these last hours: the final doors knocked, the final calls made, the final reminders to get to the polls.** [**So, friend, with just hours to go, will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can to our Michigan Battleground Victory Fund to help Christina, Sean, and me finish strong?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142784004/658054377/264474622?refcode=em-11.2.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZmZkNjllOC0yMWQ3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vxXgN019mLlES0pKxFshA1kl1KFwvVg5prUWRGnmFZY=) __If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: __ | | | [Chip in $10 Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142784005/658054379/264474622?refcode=em-11.2.26-all&express_lane=true&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZmZkNjllOC0yMWQ3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vxXgN019mLlES0pKxFshA1kl1KFwvVg5prUWRGnmFZY=)

clean_body: | Friend, This is the last email I’ll send you before the polls close. Before we head into the final hours of this campaign, I wanted to share a few things I’ve been thinking about. Over these last two years, I’ve had the chance to sit down with folks all across mid-Michigan: at union halls and diners, on front porches and in church basements. = So many people have told me the same thing in different ways. They’re working hard, doing everything right, and still coming up short at the end of the month. Groceries, prescriptions, child care, rent: it all adds up, and for a lot of families, there's just not enough left over. But those conversations are also what keep me going. Every time someone tells me what they’re carrying, I’m reminded why I do this work: to fight for affordable health care, to protect programs like SNAP and Medicare, and to bring costs down so working families can get ahead again. And to do it by bringing people together, not pulling them apart. That’s why this fight is bigger than this race. Sean McCann in MI-04 and Christina Hines in MI-10 are running because they believe what I believe: that anyone in Michigan who works hard should be able to buy a home, raise a family, and retire with dignity. With them in Congress, we can get so much more done for this state – and the nation. All three of our races are close, and they’ll come down to what we do in these last hours: the final doors knocked, the final calls made, the final reminders to get to the polls. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for everything, friend. clean_body: I cannot let this go unanswered. | When I was a young man, I served my country in the U.S. Army. Later I became an FBI special agent. Nobody told me public service was something to be afraid of. Peter, that is why what a Democrat Senator from Michigan said last week stopped me cold. Speaking at the University of Chicago on October 13, the Democrat Senator admitted that she wants to go after not just President Trump, but “the people who enabled him.” Then she said she wants young people coming out of school to think twice before they go work for the Trump administration. In her own words: “I want that deterrence message.” if you work for or support President Trump we will come for you. They have already tried to impeach the President multiple times, tried to jail him and his family, they’ve gone after Elon and had lists of every Trump supporter. My opponent, El-Sayed, supports all of this. He will be a SURE vote for Schumer to weaponize the government against political opponents. I have spent my career encouraging young Americans to serve. Democrats want the youth to be scared to be conservative. Now ask yourself what happens if my opponent, Abdul El-Sayed, wins this race. Do you think he would stand up to these unhinged Democrats? Or would he stand right next to them? If El-Sayed wins, Democrats will get their wish and have free range to target and go after President Trump and anyone who supports him, including folks like us. I am running so Michigan has a Senator who will encourage young people to serve our great nation regardless of political affiliation, not deter them away. But with 1 day left, I cannot do it alone. Here’s why this matters to me. My great-grandparents fled to America from a place where they had no freedom to choose their leaders. So, I know Democracy is precious, and it must never be taken for granted. That’s why I do what I do. I’m in the democracy business, and I’ve been to all 87 Minnesota counties to see it up close.
I’ve also met the people who run our elections. They’re professionals who count carefully, follow the law, and don’t rattle. It’s been a year of chaos from Washington, from the fight over our voters’ private data to the threats against election officials, and they have stayed calm through all of it.
Tomorrow, I expect Minnesota’s polling places to be islands of calm: high turnout, low drama.
Here’s your plan:
→ Pick your time. Any time between 7 a.m. and 8 p.m. counts.
→ [**Click here to find your polling place.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142784525/658056671/1790631974?refcode=ss_em_fr_90DO_261102&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAzNTUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgyODMwNDgtMjJkNy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNTQ0NDJlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tvaDwToA7hmgO6t38LsJIU0RnmCD4s_7Pxj4dTEHF90=&emci=74283048-22d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&emdi=78283048-22d7-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&ceid=23608046)
→ Bring a friend, a neighbor, or a family member.
And if you’ve already voted, thank you. Will you text one friend tonight and ask if they have a plan?
I can’t thank you enough for standing with me this year. Whatever tomorrow brings, I’m grateful to have had you in this fight.
Thank you for walking this path with me,
Steve

As you lie in bed tonight, the house quiet and the day finally still, think about this: **_tomorrow you might wake up in a country that no longer has the majority that protects the things you care about most._** All of it can slip away _not because_ the other side suddenly became more popular, _but because_ **enough good people like you decided, just this once, that voting wasn’t quite important enough.**
I know what you’re telling yourself. Trump’s already President. Why do I still have to show up? You’ve got a lot going on. Voting feels like one more thing. I get it. I hear it every day.
But the truth is simple and it is hard: **if we lose the House and the Senate, everything we have fought for since I walked back into that office can be stopped cold.**
The executive orders that secured the border, that cut the red tape, that put America first—those become nothing more than paper.
A single hostile committee, a single activist judge, a single speaker who hates everything we stand for, **and the progress stops.** The investigations start.
**The country you voted for in 2024 begins to unravel, not in some dramatic collapse, but in a thousand quiet votes you never cast.**
This is not just another midterm. This is the election that decides whether the America we reclaimed stays reclaimed or gets handed back, piece by piece, to the people who spent years trying to tear it down.
If we lose the majority, it will not be because patriots suddenly became Democrats. It will be because too many of us looked at the calendar, looked at the lines, looked at our own busy lives, and decided someone else would carry the load.

**There is no someone else.**
**There is only you.** ****

**_[So tonight, for maybe one more time, I’m giving Patriots the opportunity to join my MAGA Membership. As long as you promise to vote red tomorrow. Not later. Not “if I have time.” Tomorrow.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.com/click/e2625173/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS90cnVtcC1uYXRpb25hbC1jb21taXR0ZWUtamZjL2xwLXByc3AtZW1haWwtbWlkdGVybXMtMS1kYXktdjEtc2Iv/SZW1haWxfZnJlZXRoaW5rZXJkYWlseV9jb20yNjExMDM/LbmNsNXFtdTF5Ug/qP3V0bV9tZWRpdW09YnImdXRtX3Rlcm09MjM4NDJfZnRkMQ/gauk0yg/s2i1c400241)_**

**_[]()_**_If you’re with me, if you feel the weight of what’s at stake, then step forward right now._

name: Swing Left
subject: What we accomplished together this year
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
Whatever the results tomorrow night, this community helped shape them.
#
Hi there,
Happy Election Day Eve. _What a year it’s been!_
In the last 12 months, the Swing Left community worked together to build and scale Ground Truth, a new, innovative way for Democrats to do effective voter contact. We also worked to raise the significant funds needed to elect Democrats in the toughest elections across the country.
Over the course of the 2026 election cycle, we had more than 78,000 conversations with voters (and we’re still going!). That includes the voter convos volunteers had this past weekend in states like New York, Michigan, California, Texas, Colorado, and many more—making this final weekend the biggest of the midterm election cycle yet again.
[_
_](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=swing-left-2025.R-IIeA&utm_source=ak&%3Butm_medium=em&%3Butm_campaign=gt-2026&%3Butm_content=20261102-2&%3Brefcode=ak_em_gt-2026_20261102-2&t=1&akid=3385%2E1562180%2E8iKfjd)_Volunteers last weekend with Attorney General Letitia James in New York._
[_

name: Sean McCann
subject: Do you have a minute?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SEAN MCCANN FOR CONGRESS
body:
I know it’s getting late, but I just walked in the door from a busy day on the campaign trail and I had to check in.

Do you have a minute? I know it’s getting late, but I just walked in the door from a busy day on the campaign trail, and I wanted to check in one last time before Election Day. Tomorrow is our last chance to reach voters before this race is called. No matter the results, I want to say: **thank you.** For the past year and a half, supporters like you have powered this campaign, whether you’ve donated, volunteered, or simply kept up with emails like this one — we could not have gotten this far without you. A year ago, this seat was regarded as unwinnable. Political analysts thought Bill Huizenga was guaranteed a ninth term, but because of the work we have put in, we’re hours away from flipping Michigan’s Fourth and retiring Huizenga. Tomorrow _thousands_ of voters will be deciding whether they’ve heard enough from us to vote for me. That decision weighs on whether our message can reach them before they reach the polls. clean_body: We are counting on you | | | | Derek, eight years ago, you put your trust in me to lead our great state. Now, I’m asking you to put that same trust in David Crowley. He cannot become the next Governor of Wisconsin without every single grassroots Democrat standing with him, so I’m asking you personally to take the next step and pitch in before Election Day TOMORROW. | | It’s coming down to the wire. Election day is TOMORROW , and David needs you now. Tom Tiffany’s billionaire backers have been spending millions on this race. But now, we have the chance to show Tom Tiffany and MAGA Republicans that billionaire funding is no match for grassroots support. Tomorrow is Election Day.

After months of campaigning, three statewide races and more miles across South Carolina than I can count, it all comes down to the next 24 hours.

Before I ask you for anything, _I want to say thank you._

When we lost Lindsey, I didn't know how I would get through the days ahead, let alone run for the United States Senate. I never imagined being here. But you were with me from the very beginning. Your notes, your prayers, and your support carried me on days when I wasn't sure I could keep going. I will never forget that.

Now I need you with me one more time.

This race is a toss-up, and it's too important to leave anything on the table.

I am the first woman United States senator in South Carolina history. My Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, cannot be the second.

clean_body: Tomorrow we finish this. Please read my Election Eve thoughts first. | Fellow Patriot, Tomorrow is Election Day. After months of campaigning, three statewide races and more miles across South Carolina than I can count, it all comes down to the next 24 hours. Before I ask you for anything, I want to say thank you. When we lost Lindsey, I didn't know how I would get through the days ahead, let alone run for the United States Senate. I never imagined being here. But you were with me from the very beginning. Your notes, your prayers, and your support carried me on days when I wasn't sure I could keep going. I will never forget that. Now I need you with me one more time. This race is a toss-up, and it's too important to leave anything on the table. I am the first woman United States senator in South Carolina history. My Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, cannot be the second. She has a cash advantage. Millions of dollars are flooding into South Carolina from the usual liberal Super PACs: gun control groups, abortion groups, and environmental groups. She also had a huge head start while we ran three statewide races in a matter of months. They think they can buy this seat in the final hours. Every dollar raised tonight goes toward getting our voters to the polls tomorrow. When the polls open in the morning, it will be too late. I hate to ask again, especially after everything you've already done. I wouldn't ask if I didn't need it. Let's finish what we started and win again tomorrow. With gratitude, Darline Graham P.S. Thank you for standing by my side these last few months. It means more to me than I can put into words. I know you've received a lot of emails from me and others, but we cannot afford to be outspent in the final hours. | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228S.WashingtonStreet, Suite115 Alexandria,VA 22314 Don't want to receive any more of our emails? Hey everyone - I'm about to go on with Lawrence O'Donnell. If you're not able to tune in live, here's what I'm going to say:
I got off the sidelines and into this race because I saw what was happening to our country.
Donald Trump and Jon Husted and JD Vance made a lot of promises to Ohioans. They got to Washington and it became clear they were lying. Because if we look at what they do and not what they say, their priority wasn't to help farmers with the rising costs of gas and diesel. Or to fix rural health care. Or bring down the cost of groceries.
**Their priority was to get rich and help their wealthy friends get ahead - at your expense.**
Vote after vote for billionaires, crypto, Big Tech, Big Pharma, Big Oil, and Wall Street.
Vote after vote for tax cuts for the wealthy and corporations who are doing just fine.
Vote after vote to screw over working people, to make health care harder to get and more expensive, to wage reckless trade wars that drive up prices for consumers, and send our kids to fight another forever war, with no end in sight.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/be75d67b-d22e-4dd7-8ea7-2ba6ef32c305?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ohioans of all political stripes are on our team. They see the data centers going up without their say. They were promised lower costs and a better way of life, and they were betrayed. I'm hearing from these folks at our rallies in Youngstown and Toledo and Dayton. I don't take them for granted. I tell them exactly what we're going to do when I get to the Senate:
**End the war**.
**End the Trump tariffs**.
**Hold insurance companies accountable.** I'm going to fight to make it illegal for health insurance companies to play doctor and deny you the care you need. If they try to deny your claims, we'll fine them.
**Bring down prescription drug costs.** Let's make it illegal for drug companies to charge Americans more than they do in other countries, because the same pill should have the same price no matter where you live. Folks in Toledo shouldn't pay more for medication than folks in Toronto. Americans are getting ripped off by the drug companies because this Congress won't hold them accountable, but I will.
**Make data centers pay.** Jon Husted gave $2.5 billion in out-of-control tax breaks to big corporations bringing data centers to our state. They gobble up energy, devour our land, suck up our water, then they leave you with the bill. Not anymore. We're fighting to require data centers to pay the full cost of their utilities so your bills don't go up. Ohio deserves a leader who will fight to protect our communities instead of plotting to give sweetheart tax breaks to giant corporations.
**Cap utility rate increases.** While utility CEOs are raking in millions of dollars a year, your rates keep going up and up and up. Now, utilities cost more than ever and for many hardworking families, it's impossible to keep up. I'll fight to cap how much utility companies can raise your rates, to make sure your bills are affordable and predictable. I'll take on the utility companies because no Ohioan should have to choose between keeping the lights on and putting food on the table.
**Ban Congressional stock trading and lobbying.** Last year, members of Congress made more than $635 million in stock trades. No wonder they're not standing up to corporations - they're too busy lining their own pockets. And what's worse, I bet you're not even surprised by that. No one - NO ONE - who serves in Congress, or their spouse, should be able to trade stocks and make a fortune on the information they're privy to while they're representing the people. They also shouldn't be able to turn around when they leave office and become a lobbyist. If you can't agree to that, you shouldn't be in public office.
Unlike my opponent, I'm not making promises I can't keep. I will fight every day as your Senator - every second of my time in office - for working people and families.
I know you care deeply about the future of our country too. You want to help shape it for the good of the many. I'm really proud we're about to prove that winning politics and a winning campaign can be about listening to voters, telling the truth, and standing with working people. **You are the reason I got back in the fight.**
Working families around here don't have a voice in Washington. That's about to change -- and it will be thanks to you and 430,000 other people who made a donation to help us do this work on the ground. Thank you. If you can pitch in again, **[I'm going to need your support right until the end](https://substack.com/redirect/91c2ac89-b43d-4461-acdf-a371742ea7bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** - now is a great time to do that.
And if you can help us have the conversations we know we have to have before all the votes are counted tomorrow -**[sign up to volunteer with us](https://substack.com/redirect/076fdf92-5824-495e-8bf0-7d03c6109e5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
Forever grateful.
In solidarity,
Sherrod Brown

I'm hearing from these folks at our rallies in Youngstown and Toledo and Dayton. I don't take them for granted. I tell them exactly what we're going to do when I get to the Senate: End the war. End the Trump tariffs. Hold insurance companies accountable. I'm going to fight to make it illegal for health insurance companies to play doctor and deny you the care you need. If they try to deny your claims, we'll fine them. Bring down prescription drug costs. Let's make it illegal for drug companies to charge Americans more than they do in other countries, because the same pill should have the same price no matter where you live. Folks in Toledo shouldn't pay more for medication than folks in Toronto. Americans are getting ripped off by the drug companies because this Congress won't hold them accountable, but I will. Make data centers pay. Jon Husted gave $2.5 billion in out-of-control tax breaks to big corporations bringing data centers to our state. They gobble up energy, devour our land, suck up our water, then they leave you with the bill. Not anymore. We're fighting to require data centers to pay the full cost of their utilities so your bills don't go up. Ohio deserves a leader who will fight to protect our communities instead of plotting to give sweetheart tax breaks to giant corporations. Cap utility rate increases. While utility CEOs are raking in millions of dollars a year, your rates keep going up and up and up. Now, utilities cost more than ever and for many hardworking families, it's impossible to keep up. I'll fight to cap how much utility companies can raise your rates, to make sure your bills are affordable and predictable. I'll take on the utility companies because no Ohioan should have to choose between keeping the lights on and putting food on the table. Ban Congressional stock trading and lobbying. Last year, members of Congress made more than $635 million in stock trades. No wonder they're not standing up to corporations - they're too busy lining their own pockets. And what's worse, I bet you're not even surprised by that. No one - NO ONE - who serves in Congress, or their spouse, should be able to trade stocks and make a fortune on the information they're privy to while they're representing the people. They also shouldn't be able to turn around when they leave office and become a lobbyist. If you can't agree to that, you shouldn't be in public office. Unlike my opponent, I'm not making promises I can't keep. I will fight every day as your Senator - every second of my time in office - for working people and families. I know you care deeply about the future of our country too. You want to help shape it for the good of the many. I'm really proud we're about to prove that winning politics and a winning campaign can be about listening to voters, telling the truth, and standing with working people. You are the reason I got back in the fight. Working families around here don't have a voice in Washington. That's about to change -- and it will be thanks to you and 430,000 other people who made a donation to help us do this work on the ground. Thank you. If you can pitch in again, - now is a great time to do that. And if you can help us have the conversations we know we have to have before all the votes are counted tomorrow -. Forever grateful. In solidarity, Sherrod Brown | | ---|---|--- Before you click away! Republican spending in Ohio has reached $320 million, and Sherrod Brown is counting on your support to keep up. We can't outspend them, but we can outwork them. | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Friends of Sherrod Brown Friends of Sherrod Brown, 3867 West Market Street, Ste. 289 Akron, OH 44333 ? ?

Peter, Look, when I first jumped into the race to beat Mike Lawler and flip NY-17, I really didn’t know what to expect. I knew that it was going to be a hard fight. We had an initial roadmap. But a lot of it was a shot in the dark. One thing I knew for sure: I would need a massive team behind me. More than a year and a half later, we’ve built that team. And tomorrow, we are going to beat Mike Lawler and flip this district. I’m incredibly proud of how far we’ve come, and I hope you are too. Over 250 years our nation has gone through really dark times, really hard chapters. In these extraordinary moments, ordinary people rose up and chose to live with courage. They knew America and our democracy is worth fighting for. The ending to this chapter in American history is not yet written. Who we become, the values that define us, _that is up to us._ **We are the cavalry. Friend, as we enter the final hours before Election Day, I keep coming back to why I’m running for Governor — what’s at stake, and who this campaign is fighting for.
As a 35th-generation New Mexican and proud member of the Laguna Pueblo, I am of and for New Mexico through and through.
I know firsthand the struggles too many families are facing because I’ve lived them. I was a single mother raising my child on food stamps and WIC, working multiple jobs just to make ends meet. At one point, I even cleaned my child’s preschool to help cover tuition. Like so many New Mexicans, I faced impossible choices between paying rent and putting food on the table. I eventually built a small business to create more stability and flexibility for my family.
That experience is why I’m in this race: to make life easier for New Mexican families and build a future where our kids can thrive.

My campaign is about lowering costs for families, making housing more affordable, strengthening our schools, and addressing the root causes of crime to build safer communities. New Mexico is already leading the way in so many areas — from universal childcare to clean energy to preserving our rich cultural traditions. As Governor, I’ll build on that progress, keep moving our state forward, and make sure every New Mexican has he opportunity to prosper.
**Friend, I’m running for Governor for you — powered by grassroots supporters pitching in $3, $5, $20 when they can. And if I’m going to win tomorrow and hit the ground running on day one, I need your help tonight to reach my $50,000 Election Day goal by midnight.

— Deb

name: Citizens for Amanda Pusczek
subject: Tomorrow, we make history in AL-04
body:
Polls open tomorrow morning. Let’s leave everything on the field.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | Before the sun rises on Election Day, I want to pause and say something that cannot wait until the votes are counted: **_thank you._**
When we launched this campaign, the political establishment told us not to bother. They said Alabama’s 4th Congressional District was too red, too entrenched, and that a nurse who worked double shifts had no business challenging a career politician and three decades of corporate PAC money.
But they fundamentally misunderstood this district.
Because of you, we didn't just run a campaign—we built a movement that showed up in every single corner of this district. Across all 13 counties—from the rolling hills of Mentone to the river towns of Florence and Tuscumbia, down through Cullman, Russellville, and Fayette—I’ve spent the past months sitting at kitchen tables, listening outside rural clinics, and visiting factory gates.
**Everywhere I went, the message was clear: people are done being taken for granted.**
Folks are tired of watching rural hospitals shutter, healthcare bills skyrocket, and local communities get ignored while Washington insiders look the other way. For years, Robert Aderholt and his party have assumed your vote was guaranteed. Tomorrow, we remind them that in a representative democracy, power belongs to the people—not the party bosses.
Tomorrow is our day to prove it at the ballot box.
We need every single one of us to show up. Bring your family, text your neighbors, carpool to your polling place, and make our turnout impossible to ignore. Let’s break turnout records in every precinct across North Alabama.
Let’s leave nothing on the table. We are not about to wake up on Wednesday morning wishing we had knocked on one more door, made one more phone call, or brought one more voter to the polls.
**What you need to know before voting tomorrow:**
* **Poll hours:** Alabama polls are open from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM local time. As long as you are in line by 7:00 PM, you have the legal right to cast your ballot.
* **Voter ID:** Be sure to bring a valid government-issued photo ID (such as an Alabama driver's license, non-driver ID, or U.S. passport).
* **Find your precinct:** If you have any questions about where you cast your ballot, verify your polling location before heading out.

---
Win or lose, running to serve the people of Alabama's 4th District has been the absolute honor of my life. Your hospitality on front porches, your resilience in the face of tough times, and your unwavering belief in a better future have carried me through every mile of this race.
Thank you for believing in this journey. Now let’s go finish what we started.
**With profound gratitude and resolve,****Amanda Pusczek****Democratic Nominee for Congress, AL-04**

name: Heather G.
subject: One last thing before Tuesday.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| | **A FINAL MESSAGE BEFORE ELECTION DAY: **[Election Day is TOMORROW, so our Executive Director, Heather G. has a personal message for you. Read her thoughts below, then if you can, chip in to help the Voter Protection Project finish strong!](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144205?t=6&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp) | [DONATE $7 IMMEDIATELY! →](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144205?t=7&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
---
Hi friend,

Election Day is TOMORROW, I wanted to reach out personally.

And before I say anything else, I want to share a little reminder:
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144205?t=8&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
_Me, with a friendly reminder to quit bitchin' and VOTE!_
I know a lot of us are nervous about Tuesday. And I get it.

We've been here before. We've watched promising polls turn into heartbreaking election nights. We've gotten our hopes up, only to wake up the next morning wondering what went wrong.

**But I'm here to tell you something: It's okay to be hopeful.**

It's okay to believe Democrats can flip the House. It's okay to believe we have a real shot at taking back the Senate.

And it's okay to be EXCITED about it!

The polls are encouraging. Early voting is giving us reasons to be optimistic. But after everything we've been through, I know better than to take a single vote for granted.

[That's why I'm personally asking you to chip in $7, $10, or whatever you can afford to help the Voter Protection Project finish strong before Election Day.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144205?t=9&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144206?t=10&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144207?t=11&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144208?t=12&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144209?t=13&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144210?t=14&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
Here's what I keep reminding myself: **VIBES DON'T VOTE. WE DO.**

If you haven't voted yet, please make a plan.

And check in with your family, friends, neighbors, and group chats. Send them [iwillvote.com](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144214?t=15&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp) and make sure they're ready for Tuesday.

We've spent months fighting to elect voting rights champions, hold anti-voter Republicans accountable, and defend our democracy.

**Now we're just ONE DAY away from finding out what all that hard work can accomplish.**

I refuse to let the fear of losing rob us of the joy of fighting for something better. And I hope you won't either.

But hope alone isn't enough. We need to keep showing up, keep organizing, and keep fighting until the very last ballot is cast.

[Will you make one final donation before Election Day to help us finish what we started?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144205?t=16&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144206?t=17&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144207?t=18&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144208?t=19&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144209?t=20&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144210?t=21&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)
Let's bring that hope, that energy, and that JOY to the ballot box.

Now, let's go win this thing,
Heather G.
Executive Director
The Voter Protection Project

**P.S.** Friend, I know we're all exhausted. But we're too close to the finish line to slow down now. [If you can spare $7 or more, please make one final contribution to help us defeat anti-voter Republicans and elect voting rights champions on November 3rd.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/144205?t=22&akid=31181%2E878179%2EsbycGp)

body:
I know it’s getting late, but please bear with me for a moment.
Nate Silver, one of the best election forecasters out there, made a list of the most competitive governors’ races in the country. Guess who was at the very top?
**Nevada.**
Look, we knew our race would be a toss-up. But being the MOST competitive one this cycle? That's a lot of pressure. I won't pretend it isn't.
But that’s the deck we were dealt, and we have to fight with everything we’ve got to win.
**Election Day is TOMORROW.** There's very little time left to reach undecided voters.
The money we raise right now will be put toward keeping our ads up and fueling our final get-out-the-vote efforts.
MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo and his special interest backers are outspending us. But if enough members of this team step up tonight, that won't matter — we'll out-organize their millions.

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: sorry for the late email
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Hi Derek, I’m sorry
for the late email. I’ll be honest with you: I’m not getting much sleep
tonight.

I’m not nervous about the polls (I stopped following those a while ago).
It’s what’s at stake after the polls close.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23026?t=1001&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]I’ll explain more in a second. But first, while we’re both still up —
will you rush $5 right now to help us fund our last round of ads, phone
calls, and voter texts going out before the polls open?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23026?t=1002&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Chip in →

Here’s what I mean,
Derek:

No matter what happens tomorrow night, schools across this Commonwealth
open their doors Wednesday morning. A family that came up short on their
energy bill this month is still short on Thursday. A county that’s been
waiting on a bridge is still waiting. None of these struggles take
Election Day off.

What gets decided tomorrow isn’t what challenges exist. Tomorrow decides
who’s sitting in this office to address them — and whether that person
thinks it’s their challenge to solve.

I’m ready to keep getting stuff done for Pennsylvania,
Derek. And I’m so grateful for
every single person who’s been with us since the day we launched this
campaign.

Ten months. Thousands of doors knocked in counties where nobody expected
anyone to show up. Phone calls made by folks after a full shift.
Supporters on this list chipping in their hard-earned money — because they
decided this Commonwealth was worth it.

I don’t take any of it for granted,
Derek.

But there’s still so much work left to do between now and tomorrow. Our
ads have to stay up through the morning drive. We have to reach every
supporter who might let tomorrow slide past them. Almost all of it gets
paid for before midnight — and we’re still $6,585 short of where we need
to be.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23026?t=1003&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]So please,
Derek: Will you rush any amount
right now to help us turn out every last supporter and make sure Donald
Trump’s handpicked nominee isn’t the one behind this desk come next year?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23027?t=1004&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Donate $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23028?t=1005&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Donate $15 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23029?t=1006&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Donate $25 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23030?t=1007&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Donate $50 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23031?t=1008&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Donate $100 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/23026?t=1009&akid=935%2E245147%2EKPJP7s ]Other →

Thank you for everything you’ve done. Now, let’s finish strong.

— Josh Shapiro

What gets decided tomorrow isn’t what challenges exist. Tomorrow decides who’s sitting in this office to address them — and whether that person thinks it’s their challenge to solve. body:
We’ve been working toward this day for months now.
#
Hi there,
**Can you believe it? Election Day is finally here!** I’m coming to you bright and early from Southern California, where I’m making the final preparations for our voter contact phone banks happening today.
More than anything, there’s one thing I want you to hear from me: Thank you.
The Swing Left community has been working toward this day for many months now. Personally, I couldn’t be more grateful for the hard work that Swing Left volunteers and donors across the country have put in to help Democrats win, and I hope you hold that same pride today, knowing you left it all on the field.
Tonight, fingers crossed, we’ll see the positive results of all the work we’ve been doing together.
But that work isn’t done _quite_ yet! Polls don’t start closing until later this evening, which means there’s still time to turn out voters in these last few hours. And if you haven’t joined us yet, it’s not too late.
**We’re supporting campaign-led virtual phone banks all day for just that reason. So if you can,[please sign up for a shift now and help persuade as many voters as possible to cast their ballots while there’s still time left.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3252?t=1&akid=3387%2E1562180%2EPZ5-C7)**

Today’s election results will have a major impact on our country’s future. If Democrats win big tonight, they’ll be able to put a major check on Donald Trump for the final two years of his presidency. If we flip the House and Senate tonight, and make gains in key statewide races, we’ll not only shift the national balance of power away from Republicans, but we’ll have done so by building the foundation for an even stronger ground game to help Democrats continue to win in 2028, 2030, and beyond.
That brings me to my next ask: In addition to helping turn out voters today, please don’t forget to cast your OWN ballot if you haven’t already! Thank you again for every bit of time and money you contributed to help make today successful. The Swing Left community has made the difference in close races before, and I know that tonight, we’ll see that work pay off once again.
We’ll make sure to keep you updated tonight as results roll in, so keep an eye on your inbox once polls start to close!
Z Mooney

body:
Cast your ballot today!
# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=16%2E6803%2EstkWmh)
☀️ Good morning. It’s Election Day!
By this time tomorrow, we’ll know the outcome of many of our races where we’re fighting to elect true climate champions and break Big Oil’s grip on our government.
**Every vote matters, and every voice deserves to be heard. Please, if you haven’t yet voted, there’s still time![Make your voting plan right now. Visit Vote411 to look up your polling location, check voting hours, and review your ballot:](https://act.janepac.com/go/49?t=3&akid=16%2E6803%2EstkWmh)**
**[Find your polling site ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/49?t=4&akid=16%2E6803%2EstkWmh)**
In down-ballot races for city councils, utility boards, and state legislatures, just a handful of votes will decide who wins. **As you cast your ballot, don’t forget to:**
➡️ **Bring a friend:** Don't go alone. Take a coworker, neighbor, or family member with you to the polls.
➡️ **Check your circle:** Text three people right now to make sure they have a voting plan.
➡️ **Stay in line:** As long as you are in line before the polls close, you have the right to cast your ballot.
The fight for a livable future is on the line. The fossil fuel billionaires are counting on us staying home, but when we turn out, the many can beat the money.
**[Find your polling site, cast your ballot, and make your voice heard.](https://act.janepac.com/go/49?t=5&akid=16%2E6803%2EstkWmh)**
See you at the polls!
Team JanePAC
Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. The Jane Fonda Climate PAC exists to disrupt that status quo by unseating politicians in the pocket of corporate polluters and replacing them with climate champions willing to fight like hell for our planet and the communities we call home. **[If a grassroots donation of $5 is within your means, please use this link to join us in the fight for a better future, with better leaders.](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261103-ak.XFVvOd&amount=5&refcode=em20261103-16&t=6&akid=16%2E6803%2EstkWmh)** **[Donate ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261103-ak.XFVvOd&amount=5&refcode=20261103-16&t=7&akid=16%2E6803%2EstkWmh)**

name: Derek Merrin
subject: IT'S ELECTION DAY. NORTHWEST OHIO, GET OUT AND VOTE!
body:
Your Vote Matters! Head to the Polls Today and Make It Count!
| | | | |
---
| Friends,
TODAY IS THE DAY!
After months of hard work, Election Day has finally arrived.
Today, the people of Northwest Ohio have the opportunity to make their voices heard and decide who will represent them in the United States Congress.
The stakes are enormous, and every vote matters.
Our communities deserve a strong voice in Washington. The decisions made in this election will affect our economy, the cost of living, public safety, and the future we're building for our children and grandchildren.
This election is too important to sit on the sidelines.
POLLS ARE OPEN FROM 6:30 AM TO 7:30 PM!
If you haven't already voted, please make time to cast your ballot today.
Bring a valid photo ID, confirm your polling location, and make your voice heard.
Remember, elections aren't decided by polls, predictions, or political advertisements.
They're decided by the people who SHOW UP AND VOTE.
Thank you for everything you've done throughout this campaign.
Let's finish strong! Derek Merrin
---

name: Ken Martin (DNC Chair)
subject: We have the opportunity to do something big today.
body:
Derek, as voters across the country head to the polls this morning, I’m reflecting on what this team has accomplished together in the last two years. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10226%2E22930333%2EJ-_KKD)
---
Derek, as voters across the country head to the polls this morning, I’m reflecting on what this team has accomplished together in the last two years. We made _massive_ investments in state parties, allowing them to build their midterm infrastructure early. We launched _When We Count_ to regain ground in voter registration in battleground states. We supplied more than 10,000 Democratic campaigns with the data and tech infrastructure of a presidential campaign. And across the country, _Democrats have won or overperformed in nearly 90% of key elections_ since Donald Trump took office. All of that has _only_ been possible because of our army of grassroots supporters. **Thank you for being a part of that team.** Time and time again, you’ve stepped up to help out when the going gets tough. Today, [**I’m reaching out to ask for your support one last time before polls begin to close in key battlegrounds in 10 hours.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.gb4rMu&refcode=em_20261103_10220_fr&amount=7&t=6&akid=10226%2E22930333%2EJ-_KKD) Democrats have the opportunity to do something big today. Donald Trump and JD Vance promised Americans they would bring down prices, drain the swamp, end wars, and fight for the forgotten men and women of this country. Instead of delivering on those promises, they made our country’s problems worse. At every level of government, Republicans have enabled Trump and Vance’s higher costs, endless chaos, and rampant corruption. **Americans have judged that record for themselves, and today, they’re going to hold them accountable.** They’re going to go to the polls and elect representatives who will fight for _us_ , not for billionaires. But we can’t congratulate ourselves just yet. Until the very last race is called, my team is going to be working around the clock to reach voters, cure ballots, and give Democrats across the country the best possible shot at victory. subject: We could be hearing one of Trump’s favorite words a lot
body:
[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1007&refcode=20261103_MJ_T1&akid=302%2E344797%2EzmFD6f ]COURIER Newsroom

Hi Peter — Mark Jacob here, contributor at COURIER.

It's finally Election Day. And according to recent polling, only 28% of
Americans are confident that Donald Trump will accept tonight's results if
his party loses.

Which means we could be hearing one of Trump’s favorite words – “rigged” –
a lot in the coming weeks and months.

If he attempts to overturn a fair election, as he tried six years ago, it
will be up to the news media to remind the public that false claims of
unfairness are on-brand for him.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1003&refcode=20261103_MJ_T1&akid=302%2E344797%2EzmFD6f ]Before you read on, I hope you will consider making a donation today to
support COURIER Newsroom. COURIER's reporters are on the ground right now
in communities across the nation covering the races that will decide this
midterm election. And with your support, they will continue to make sure
factual information reaches voters no matter what Trump or his MAGA
oligarch allies in the media try to pull in the days and weeks ahead.

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1004&refcode=20261103_MJ_T1&akid=302%2E344797%2EzmFD6f ]DONATE

Here are 25 things Trump says were rigged, faked, or stolen:

1. The Emmy Awards

After Trump’s “The Apprentice” repeatedly lost to “The Amazing Race,” he
called it “a con game” and claimed, “I would have won the Emmy many times
except for my politics.”

2. Climate change warnings

Trump tweeted in 2012 that climate change concerns were rigged: “The
concept of global warming was created by and for the Chinese in order to
make U.S. manufacturing non-competitive.”

3. The 2016 Iowa caucus

“Ted Cruz didn’t win Iowa, he stole it.”

4. The legal case against Trump University

When victims of Trump’s university scam sued, he declared, “I am getting
railroaded by ... a rigged system.” He claimed the “Mexican” judge (who was
born in Indiana) was biased against him and ultimately settled by paying
$25 million.

5. The 2016 Democratic primaries

“President Obama should ask the DNC about how they rigged the election
against Bernie.”

6. The investigation of Hillary Clinton’s emails

“Rigged,” according to a Trump tweet.

7. Trump’s first debate with Clinton

He called it a “rigged deal,” claiming he was intentionally given a faulty
microphone and that moderator Lester Holt was out to get him.

8. The 2016 general election (before he won)

“The election is absolutely being rigged by the dishonest and distorted
media pushing Crooked Hillary - but also at many polling places - SAD.”

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1005&refcode=20261103_MJ_T1&akid=302%2E344797%2EzmFD6f ]DONATE

9. The 2016 general election (even after he won)

Trump lost the popular vote to Hillary Clinton by nearly 3 million votes,
but he claimed he would’ve won it if 3-5 million undocumented immigrants
hadn’t cast ballots. (A total lie.)

10. The Mueller probe

Trump said he was persecuted by an investigation run by Robert Mueller, a
special counsel named by Trump’s own Justice Department to look into ties
between Russia and his 2016 campaign. “Mueller and his gang ... make Joseph
McCarthy look like a baby! Rigged Witch Hunt!”

11. The Nobel Peace Prize

Trump said in 2018 that “everyone” thought he deserved a Nobel Prize. A
year later, he said he “would get a Nobel Prize for a lot of things if
they give it out fairly, which they don’t.” After missing out again this
year, he said the snub left “an indelible stain on the country of Norway.”

12. Google’s search results

Trump said they were “rigged” to showcase liberal media outlets.

13. The media (of course)

“It’s the Rigged Media ... and it is what I’m up against.”

14. The 2020 election

“The 2020 Presidential Election was MANIPULATED and RIGGED by the DOJ,”
Trump claimed, citing a fake statistic that 20% of mail-in ballots were
“rigged or defective.” He’s been repeating his lie about 2020 ever since.

15. His own followers’ riot at the Capitol

Trump said the FBI “secretly placed” agents in the crowd to foment the
disorder. He also said, “Nancy Pelosi is responsible, because she refused
to take the 10,000 soldiers or National Guardsmen that I offered.” (Both
are ridiculous lies.)

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1006&refcode=20261103_MJ_T1&akid=302%2E344797%2EzmFD6f ]DONATE

16. The civil business fraud case against Trump

New York Attorney General Letitia James sued Trump and other Trump
Organization figures for claiming widely different property values,
depending on whether they were talking to potential lenders or tax
officials. Trump posted about “racist A.G. James’ CORRUPT & RIGGED case

“I probably would’ve won all 50 [states] if we had an honest count,” he

“It looked like another rigged election, frankly.”

Trump keeps claiming that hecklers at his rallies are “paid protesters”
despite no evidence of that whatsoever.

| Friend, it's Angie Nixon.
---
| The Vice President of the United States flew into Florida and told a cheering crowd that I don't belong in America.
---
| Let that sit for a second. The Vice President, standing on a tarmac in my home state, telling a Black woman whose ancestors helped build this country with their own hands, that she should get out.
---
| I don't need JD Vance's permission to belong here.
---
| My family has been in Florida for generations. We built this country. We bled for it. We worked the land, raised the children, and did the jobs nobody else wanted to do, all while being told at every turn that we didn't quite belong.
---
| And now, a man who has never had to prove he belongs anywhere is lecturing me about America while standing next to a senator who was never even elected to the seat she holds.
---
| [Can you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can right now to help me fight back against these out-of-touch Republicans?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kr1c4Ca8Az0_GAVLURCGg6hqAmpvVXYTWMCoLUak2TAhzEAZqnHZX9qovw54TxjrSTjkRn3VfNVugXqmZehKvO1ACELvvx6biRbIvmJ-mFcT2c7YKkUrDh4UoesRzj_D7RcYmNqAEhmHOAqsnaHX5-SB0WI3beRitUm9gewiDf5vEqxDSdJE_3zp9x_iNnTWg-p8TLWIogTDkGj5jKZOY41bD9Blxp3cVlAalOpW5pj3eM6aab70PAgV_szfhmTU&c=Bmaj9cjqcJLaDuzxnsDo38_sch2OkPMr7TO1IbtfngFZ66IynLt-RQ==&ch=og2DXqF9M5pMOY73G2wgiUZF_eR1HfZza9vV526rg50cbKe5elQtqQ==)

| Let's be clear about what that was really about: it was a distraction, and a desperate one.

| When you can't defend record-high insurance premiums, skyrocketing rent, and a healthcare system that bankrupts working families, the easiest thing to do is make the conversation about anything else. So they flew in a Vice President to do their dirty work.

| I'm not interested in being anyone's distraction.

body:
If you haven’t had a chance to cast your ballot, do it today!
#
Happy Election Day, Peter.
If you have had the opportunity to cast your ballot, today is your last chance. [**You can use this link here to find your Election Day polling location!**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/869?utm_source=20261103-753&t=1&akid=753%2E1366028%2Eln6nQq)
**[Find a Polling Location](https://act.votolatino.org/go/869?utm_source=20261103-753&t=2&akid=753%2E1366028%2Eln6nQq)**
Here are 5 things you need to know about your voting rights.
1. You have a right to cast your ballot free from any intimidation.
2. You have a right to cast a provisional ballot.
3. You have a right to vote if you are in line before polls close.
4. You have a right to bring someone with you to the polling place if you need translation.
5. Each state has a different approach to mail ballots – verify your county election office’s eligibility requirements.

For help, reach out to the National Election Protection Hotline: 866-OUR-VOTE
Thank you for exercising your right to vote,
Voto Latino
P.S. With just a few hours remaining until the polls close, Voto Latino is texting voters with the information they need to vote with confidence — what their rights are at the polls, what to do if they feel intimidated, and where to get help in English and/or Spanish. Every dollar we raise right now helps us reach another voter. [**Can you chip in a last-minute donation of $3 to fund our texts?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261103-1.N0nWUl&amount=3&refcode=em20261103-753&t=3&akid=753%2E1366028%2Eln6nQq)

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Alaska and Iowa
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
This close to the election, you don’t have time to make up the gap if you do end up falling short.
#

Team, it’s a question as good as any other right now.
“Why am I still getting asked to donate to campaigns now, this close to the election?”
And it’s a question I can answer, if you’ll let me.
I ran a campaign in 2020, and another in 2022. What we raised in 2020 was the best indication of what we might raise in 2022. From the beginning of that campaign, we built out projections based on that information.
You need to know how much you can expect to raise because that tells you how much you can expect to spend. Every dollar goes toward reaching and turning out voters. And in races that can be determined by just a few thousand, even a few hundred votes, that information is absolutely critical.
Campaigns have to project how much they’re going to raise over those last few days before the election, same as any other time. That’s budgeted. It’s how you fully fund your final advertisements, get-out-the-vote efforts, rallies, and the last rounds of payroll for staff who have worked night and day for you for months, sometimes years.
This close to the election, you don’t have time to make up the gap if you do end up falling short. That makes these final days the most stressful of the campaign, and that’s why you’re still getting fundraising requests.
I’ve been there, and I know what that’s like. So, I’m going to do what I can over these final hours to try to help out.
[**Right now, what that means is asking you to split a donation between Josh Turek’s campaign in Iowa, Mary Peltola’s in Alaska, and mine. I’m supporting both of them, their races are close, and they deserve your help. Maine voters go to the polls Tuesday to bring a merciful end to Election Month. For just 18 months or so, the inundation of junk mail and ominous television ads will disappear. In place of the overt attempts to seize power by monied interests, Mainers will be subjected to the repercussions of how those monied interests wield that power. Polls close at 8 p.m. If you haven't voted yet, you can look up your polling location [here](https://substack.com/redirect/5d27917c-e3f2-494a-a732-1943c0ce3a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). If you need an interpreter to help you translate "needle exchange clinic" into Somali, you can try Abdullahi Ali's cellphone...

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dy7WNa0TaJMA6x6cfZVbrJ0SijidlsMD4hYQBnvfuG0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=223225307)
Outside groups have poured more than $190 million into Maine's federal and state races, according to a Maine Wire review of independent-expenditure filings with the Federal Election Commission through Nov. 2 and the Maine Ethics Commission through Nov. 1. Independent expenditures are ads, mail and canvassing paid for by groups that by law may not coordinate with the candidates.
## [Election Fraud: DOJ Investigating Somali "Translators" Caught on CCTV Coaching Illiterate Migrant Voters](https://substack.com/redirect/438fe6c7-5987-4239-97a1-623805b654e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [The Robinson Report](https://substack.com/profile/147548156-the-robinson-report)| | *
---|---|---
| Oct 30
[](https://substack.com/redirect/438fe6c7-5987-4239-97a1-623805b654e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[The Department of Justice is investigating CCTV video from Lewiston City Hall that appears to show dozens of instances of NGO workers -- operating as "interpreters" -- coaching illiterate Somalis on how to vote and even filling out ballots for them.](https://substack.com/redirect/438fe6c7-5987-4239-97a1-623805b654e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/438fe6c7-5987-4239-97a1-623805b654e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Senate race drew $148.2 million, $141.2 million of it in the general election. Groups spent $74.5 million against Jackson and $13.7 million for him. They spent $38.6 million against Collins and $7.3 million for her. Another $11.1 million went against Platner before he withdrew, most of it in the general-election period. The biggest spenders were [SLF PAC, a super PAC](https://substack.com/redirect/54165471-61b8-460a-8ca7-779fbc7e577a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at $39.1 million, mostly against Jackson; WinSenate at $38.1 million, mostly against Collins; and Pine Tree Results PAC at $31 million against Jackson and Platner.
In the 2nd District, outside groups spent $26.2 million, $24.5 million of it in the general election. Groups spent $13.2 million against Dunlap and $1.7 million for him, and $9 million against LePage and $598,293 for him. A committee filing as HMP spent $9 million against LePage. One filing as CLF spent $7 million and Safety & Affordability PAC $5.3 million against Dunlap. The 1st District drew almost nothing: one $10 expenditure for Pingree, by the Sierra Club, in FEC records.
State races drew $18.5 million in independent expenditures reported to the Ethics Commission through Nov. 1, including primaries. The governor's race accounted for $12.4 million over the 2026 cycle, including the primaries. Counting only spending dated June 10 or later, after the primary, groups spent $3.09 million against Charles and $345,994 for him, $700,306 for Pingree and $636,343 against her, and $283,680 for Bennett. Restoration of America PAC Maine spent $3.97 million, nearly all of it backing Garrett Mason in the Republican primary. Pine Tree State Prosperity spent $2.71 million against Charles between Sept. 18 and Oct. 23.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/96b25190-b842-47a0-bbf6-bef36a4332a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Legislative races drew $4.7 million: $2.35 million in House races and $2.34 million in Senate races.
